question: In good daylight, from what minimum distance must you be able to read a new-style vehicle number plate?
explanation: You MUST be able to read a vehicle number plate, in good daylight, from a distance of 20 metres (or 20.5 metres for old-style number plates). If you need to wear glasses or contact lenses to do this, you MUST wear them at all times while driving. (Highway Code rule 92.)

question: How often must a car normally pass an MOT test once it is three years old?
explanation: Every year. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: At what age does a car normally first require an MOT certificate?
explanation: Three years from first registration. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: What is the minimum level of motor insurance required to drive on public roads?
explanation: Third-party cover. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: A police officer asks to see your driving documents but you do not have them with you. What may you be required to do?
options: Show them to any officer within 14 days
Produce them at a police station within seven days
explanation: Produce them at a police station within seven days. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: Under the New Drivers Act, your licence will be revoked if you reach how many penalty points within two years of passing your first test?
explanation: Six or more. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: Who may supervise a learner car driver on a public road?
options: Someone aged at least 21 who has held a full licence for that category for at least three years
explanation: Someone aged at least 21 who has held a full licence for that category for at least three years. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: What must you do if you keep an untaxed vehicle off the public road?
options: Nothing, provided it is on private land
Make a Statutory Off Road Notification (SORN)
Display a “not in use” notice in the windscreen
explanation: Make a Statutory Off Road Notification (SORN). Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: When MUST L plates be displayed on a vehicle?
options: Only during driving lessons with an instructor
For 12 months after passing the test
Whenever it is being driven by a learner
explanation: Whenever it is being driven by a learner. Source: The Highway Code, Annex 3 (Motor vehicle documentation).

question: Highway Code rule 90 is about “rules for drivers and motorcyclists”. Which statement is taken from this rule?
options: The driver MUST ensure that all children under 14 years of age in cars, vans and other goods vehicles wear seat belts or sit in an approved child restraint where required.
Make sure that you are fit to drive.
You MUST NOT drive under the influence of drugs or medicine.
Slow down, and if necessary stop, if you are dazzled by bright sunlight.
explanation: Make sure that you are fit to drive. You MUST report to the DVLA any health condition likely to affect your driving. (Highway Code rule 90.)
